led-ceiling-fan-remote.title: LED Ceiling Fan with Remote
led-ceiling-fan-remote.description: Ultra-flat ceiling fan with LED ring, remote control, and reversible summer/winter motor. Ideal for bedroom and living room: 6 speeds, natural breeze mode, 2H/4H timer, and night light for comfortable sleep.

funwater-koi-sup.title: FunWater Koi Paddle — Complete Kit
funwater-koi-sup.description: Inflatable FunWater stand-up paddle with Koi design. Complete kit: paddle, pump, leash, fins, backpack, dry bag, and repair kit. Stable, light, and ready for the whole family.

funwater-tiki-blue-sup.title: FunWater Tiki Blue Paddle — Complete Kit
funwater-tiki-blue-sup.description: Inflatable FunWater Tiki paddle (blue tribal pattern). Summer offer: 990 DT instead of 1100 DT. Complete set for beginners and advanced — stable, high quality, light, and durable.

funwater-tiki-pink-sup.title: FunWater Tiki Pink Paddle — Complete Kit
funwater-tiki-pink-sup.description: Pink version of FunWater Tiki. Same complete kit and same special summer price 990 DT. Perfect for beach, lake, and family weekends.

funwater-shepherd-sup.title: FunWater German Shepherd Paddle — Complete Kit
funwater-shepherd-sup.description: FunWater paddle with German Shepherd graphics. Complete kit with optional kayak seat, pump, paddle, leash, and carry bag. Stable and solid for all levels.

funwater-eagle-sup.title: FunWater Eagle Paddle — Complete Kit
funwater-eagle-sup.description: FunWater Eagle — premium set at 1250 DT. Eagle design, complete kit (seat, pump, leash, fins, bag). Durable, stable, easy to carry and inflate.

electric-sup-pump.title: 12V Digital Electric Pump for Paddle
electric-sup-pump.description: Portable electric pump with digital display and multiple nozzles. Powered by 12V (cigarette lighter) — ideal for paddle, kayak, inflatable tent, and balls. Perfect accessory with our SUP kits.

robot-vacuum-auto-empty.title: LiDAR Robot Vacuum with Auto-Empty
robot-vacuum-auto-empty.description: Robot vacuum with precise LiDAR navigation, App / Alexa / Google control, and auto-empty station up to 90 days. Multi-floor mapping, obstacle avoidance, and jam-free cleaning.

air-track-mat.title: Gymnastics Air Track — Complete Kit
air-track-mat.description: Inflatable air track mat with green center line for alignment. Kit with electric pump, carry bag, and repair kit. Gymnastics, taekwondo, cheerleading, outdoor, and home.

google-tv-projector.title: Google TV Projector 2200 ANSI HDR10
google-tv-projector.description: Official smart Google TV projector — 10K+ content, Netflix, YouTube and more. Cinema quality ANSI 2200 + HDR10, AI optimization, UltraClear contrast and sharpness.

lisowod-smart-projector.title: Lisowod Smart Projector — Summer Offer
lisowod-smart-projector.description: Lisowod projector — special summer price 990 DT (instead of 1100 DT). 800+ apps, Live TV, and AI Auto-Setup for quick install and instant home cinema.
